value.rationale: The two-arity type counts are a natural low-dimensional numerical probe of a finite named base in an oligomorphic wreath product. Their sharp first failure to reconstruct an E-class-size partition occurs at a meaningful minimal ten-point boundary and has a unique two-profile fiber, while a uniform arity-three separator of 3200 survives in every larger size. This simultaneously gives a complete minimal cutoff and an explicit infinite obstruction family, without claiming reconstruction of base orientation.
